security_audit.summary: The shell-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and a fenced curl example. The skill legitimately documents outbound Mailtrap email sends, which is a real medium-risk capability. It also mentions raw Handlebars HTML without sanitization guidance, and no prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any live send, and default examples to sandbox or test recipients.
Warn users to avoid triple-brace variables unless content is trusted and sanitized.
Keep token values in environment variables and never ask users to paste tokens into prompts or logs.

content.value_statement: Email teams need reliable template payloads and personalization without guessing API fields. This skill guides Mailtrap template sends, Handlebars variables, sandbox previews, and SDK choices.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Mailtrap-hosted templates and template UUIDs.
Shows how template variables map to Handlebars placeholders.
Distinguishes transactional and bulk Mailtrap sending streams.
Points users to official API references and SDK repositories.
Recommends sandbox previews before risky template changes.
limitations: It does not create Mailtrap templates without account access.
It does not verify SDK signatures unless current docs are checked.
It does not send email by itself without user-provided integration steps.
It does not sanitize raw HTML variables for users.

use_cases.title: Implement transactional template sends
use_cases.description: Map a welcome, password reset, or receipt flow to a Mailtrap template payload.

use_cases.title: Prepare personalized campaign templates
use_cases.description: Plan bulk email variables, conditional sections, and stream selection for promotional sends.

use_cases.title: Review template testing workflows
use_cases.description: Check sandbox preview steps before a template change reaches real recipients.

prompt_templates.title: Identify template fields
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new template.
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Mailtrap fields I need for a template-based transactional email. Include required sender, recipient, template UUID, and variables.

prompt_templates.title: Map variables to Handlebars
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these template variables and explain how they should map to Handlebars placeholders, conditionals, and nested paths.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the sending stream
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me decide whether this Mailtrap template send should use transactional or bulk email. Explain the host and testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a template workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Mailtrap template workflow for payload shape, SDK documentation checks, sandbox preview, and unsafe raw HTML variables.

output_examples.input: I need to send a welcome email from a Mailtrap template.
output_examples.output: Use the transactional stream, get the template UUID from the Integration tab, and pass variables that match the template placeholders.

output_examples.input: My template uses names, order rows, and optional discount text.
output_examples.output: Use escaped placeholders for names, loop over order rows, and guard discount text with a conditional block.

output_examples.input: We changed a promotional template before launch.
output_examples.output: Preview it through the sandbox workflow first, then confirm the bulk stream and recipient list before any live send.

best_practices: Read the current SDK README before generating SDK-specific code.
Use sandbox previews before live sends or risky template edits.
Keep template variable names aligned with the Handlebars placeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not mix literal body content with template UUID sends.
Do not use raw HTML variables for untrusted user content.
Do not guess API payload shapes when official docs are available.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps users build Mailtrap email template payloads and understand Handlebars personalization.

faq.question: Does it create templates in Mailtrap?
faq.answer: It explains UI and API paths, but account access and credentials remain with the user.

faq.question: Can it help with transactional and bulk email?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains which Mailtrap stream and host to use for each send type.

faq.question: Does it include SDK guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It links to SDK repositories and tells the agent to check current READMEs first.

faq.question: How should templates be tested?
faq.answer: Use Mailtrap sandbox preview workflows before sending risky changes to real recipients.

faq.question: Is raw HTML safe in variables?
faq.answer: Only trusted and sanitized HTML should use raw output. Escaped placeholders are safer by default.
